title: ADR-0003: JWT bearer auth with a per-request user re-check
summary: Adopts short-lived HS256 JWTs via OAuth2 password flow with argon2id hashing, re-loading the user from the database on every request for immediate revocation.
notes: Filename hash suffix is a placeholder (nohash00): no shell was available to compute the SHA-256 of the source path. Slug is unique, so no collision is expected.
